# QuotaBurn

> Agent cost & usage-limit tracker: plans, usage limits and per-token API prices for AI coding agents, each with an official source URL and last-verified date (data verified 2026-10-13).

- [Model API prices](https://quotaburn.com/models/)

## Quick facts
- Claude Fable 5.1 (Anthropic): $10 input / $50 output per 1M tokens (verified 2026-10-13, https://claude.com/pricing)
- Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic): $4 input / $20 output per 1M tokens (verified 2026-10-13, https://claude.com/pricing)
- Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Anthropic): $2 input / $10 output per 1M tokens (verified 2026-10-13, https://claude.com/pricing)
